images.caption: Houses on the southern edge of Dwyran. Dwyran is a quiet, rural village located in the south-west of Anglesey, Wales, known for its tranquil atmosphere and proximity to natural coastal beauty. The name translates from Welsh to "two strands," reflecting its historical ties to the land and the nearby tidal waters. The village serves as a convenient base to access major regional attractions, most notably the expansive Newborough Warren and Forest, a protected nature reserve leading to the scenic Llanddwyn Island. It sits near the Menai Strait, an area rich in birdlife and offering picturesque views toward the Snowdonia mountain range on the mainland.

description: This walk takes you along the River Braint from the village of Dwyran on Anglesey. Starting in the village the walk heads south west to pick up a footpath along the river. Continue west and you will soon come to the photogenic stepping stones where you can cross to the other side of the water. Along the way there are some fine views over the surrounding countryside to enjoy.You can continue your walking in the area by picking up theLlyn Rhos-Ddu to Moel Y Don Walkand theNewborough Forest Saint Sand and Sea Trail.
